notes_for_editor: No record corrections needed. The 1993 cause is disputed: firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts say a vandal set it over the winter; Forest Lookouts says a stranded camper accidentally burned the building and garage later in 1993. The story reports both without choosing. Idaho Fire Lookouts tags the site Drive-Up Burned, so the story reports that label as a suggestion of road access and says no source confirms current access. The 1959 telephone relay rests on one hobby-site page quoting the Idaho State Journal. No Forest Service record was found.
